pages.text: The nine curses do not all lead downward forever. When certain marks are triggered correctly, punishment turns into a different order.$(br2)The result is not always gentle, but raw oppression becomes power that can be used, endured, or exchanged.

pages.title: Known Reversals
pages.text: $(li)Curse I: Place every configured offering into a water-filled cauldron and await the Trial Cup of the Two Gods.$(li)Curse II: Complete all three waves of the Ember of Duat's undead trial.$(li)Curse V: First endure the maximum-Guilt punishment, then make the single choice offered during sleep.$(li)Curse VI: Complete the final exchange on the central End island.$(li)Curse VIII: Enter the Nether, then defeat a boss on the configured allowlist.$(li)Curse IX: Defeat the configured creatures and eat the configured number of distinct nourishing foods.

pages.title: Final Release
pages.text: Curse III, the Tax Seal of the Throne Name, and Curse IV, the Tribute Pact of Two Lands, have no independent reward reversal. Once the other true marks have been turned, both tax pacts collapse together.$(br2)Experience tax, enchanting tax, anvil tax, and trade surcharges then disappear from both mechanics and interfaces.

pages.title: Curse V: Two Paths
pages.text: The Scale of the Innocent is the only mark that demands an explicit choice.$(br)$(li)Accept reversal: Guilt becomes Mercy. At 1,299 Mercy, one death reversal can be stored.$(li)Refuse reversal: the old curse remains, but grants dangerous bonuses as Guilt approaches its limit, increasing attack, health, armor, movement speed, and experience gain.$(br2)Neither choice can be undone.

pages.title: Rewards After Reversal
pages.text: $(li)Curse I: random afflictions become random beneficial effects when struck.$(li)Curse II: villager infection ends, lost Luck becomes a bonus, and loyal retainers may arrive.$(li)Curse V: gain Mercy and death reversal, or retain the old curse as a high-risk power source.$(li)Curse VI: permanent creative flight, doubled drops, and Strength II.$(li)Curse VIII: main-hand damage may be redirected into the target.$(li)Curse IX: Hunger Debt, Satiety Crystals, and hunger penalties cease; hunger never decreases.

pages.title: Curse VII: Judgment of the End
pages.text: After reversal, the active seal grants permanent combat bonuses; End damage reduction and End experience multiplier follow the configuration. Each cycle triggers judgment at a random point within at most seven effective attacks, marking selected enemies with a textureless procedural red arrow above their heads.
